absent: Synchronization and locking requirements for capability flags and per processor storage are not shown.
Callers, ordering and privilege context of early, boot and full initialization hooks beyond their chaining are not shown.
Behavior when register accesses fault outside the guarded probes is not shown.
Power management suspend ordering relative to other syscore operations is not shown.
Layout of processor descriptor tables and interrupt handling is not shown.

findings.text: Defective revision record associates a combined family model identifier with a stepping value and a revision threshold for matching affected parts.
Activation register identifier for memory encryption enablement is value 0x982.
Locked indication uses the lowest bit, enabled indication uses the next bit, and key identifier width uses four bits beginning at position thirty two.

Defective speculation microcode test exempts virtualized guests and otherwise matches current family model plus stepping against a fixed table, treating a revision at or below the tabulated limit as defective.

Early encryption probe requires both locked and enabled indications, otherwise it withdraws the capability, and when present with nonzero key width it reduces reported physical address bits by that width.

Combined family model helper derives its value from processor identification leaf one, and the platform helper returns zero under a hypervisor or for very early models before reading firmware state on newer parts.
Global platform helper exposes a small firmware derived identifier for eligible parts.
Global predicate reports whether the boot processor falls in an early stepping range associated with a documented memory erratum.

Early per processor setup refreshes revision and platform state, withdraws speculation controls on defective revisions, and adjusts cache alignment, address width, timer, string, paging and encryption related capabilities plus a memory ordering quirk.

Main processor setup chains early setup, errata handling, cache description, monitoring and tracing capability detection, model specific bug marking, vector width preference, node placement, feature control, miscellaneous features, split lock and thermal setup.
Boot processor hook delegates to resource control detection.

Vendor descriptor binds vendor strings and numeric vendor value to callbacks for translation cache discovery and for early, boot and full initialization, with extra legacy naming and cache sizing support on 32 bit builds.

Errata handling conditionally marks lockup, interrupt controller, flush and monitor issues, suppresses fast system entry on old steppings, optionally forces address extension, disables prefetch on one stepping, tunes bulk move alignment preference and checks secondary processor steppings, while an alternate build is an empty operation.

Node helper preserves the existing assignment when fresh lookup is unavailable or offline, and miscellaneous feature setup clears a per processor shadow, probes faulting and wait related support, then writes back the combined control.
Cache size helper substitutes fixed defaults for two special models when firmware reports zero or unconditionally for a tiny on chip cache.

Translation cache discovery requires availability of the descriptor leaf, then walks architectural descriptors and retains maximum entry counts per instruction, data, shared and page size category with combined handling for large page entries.
Fixed match list identifies families where wide vector use is discouraged so setup prefers narrower width on matches.
Energy bias value occupies the low four bits, a saved marker uses the next bit, and the maximum accepted numeric value equals the low bits mask.
Energy level enumeration orders five steps from performance toward power saving, backed by parallel tables of hardware encodings and user visible names.

Suspend captures the masked hardware setting plus a marker into per processor storage, and resume restores the masked value when marked, otherwise normalizes a first online zero performance value to the normal level with a one time notice, always preserving upper bits.

Per device attributes expose the current hardware bias as decimal text and accept either a symbolic level name or a numeric value within the mask range through a read modify write that preserves reserved bits.

Forced address extension taints the kernel as out of specification, symmetric multiprocessing on certain mid range steppings warns about unreliability, and an integrated interrupt controller on specific early steppings is flagged as buggy.
